summary: Feature implemented but not verified: no tests, linter, or examples were run (per instructions), and nothing was committed. Changes: new monai/data/csv_saver.py (CSVSaver) and monai/data/nifti_saver.py (NiftiSaver); plot_2d_or_3d_image added to monai/visualize/img2tensorboard.py; SegmentationSaver, ClassificationSaver, and TensorBoardImageHandler reduced to thin adapters over the savers and plot function; write_nifti default dtype changed to np.float32; output_path renamed to output_dir in two segmentation examples and tests/integration_sliding_window.py. New tests: test_csv_saver.py, test_nifti_saver.py, test_handler_segmentation_saver.py, test_plot_2d_or_3d_image.py; test_handler_classification_saver.py now passes filename. Choices: NIfTI writes data.dtype when no dtype is set (avoids astype(None) float64); CSV finalize skips blank rows; no docs pages added. Pre-existing issue not fixed: tests/test_handler_tb_image.py uses os, glob, shutil without importing them, so it will likely fail with NameError. Static check only: no changed file has lines over 120 characters or trailing spaces.
